title: On How Kelsenian Jurisprudence and Intuitionistic Logic help to avoid Contrary-to-Duty paradoxes in Legal Ontologies
reasoning: The paper formalizes deontic logic (the logic of obligation and duty) to resolve normative paradoxes like the Chisholm paradox. It specifically addresses 'Natural Law', legal jurisprudence, and the formalization of 'ought' statements, which are core components of formal ethics and moral reasoning.
